Roads and places change. The computer remakes it from fresh OpenStreetMap data: Tetra › Settings › Maps.
Tetra comes without a map, so everyone gets the map they want, offline and their own. You make it once, on your computer:

1. On your computer, open Tetra › Settings › Maps › Add a map.
2. Choose your country. The computer needs internet for this.
3. Keep the computer on and plugged in while the map is made: a few minutes for a small country, an hour or more for a big one.
4. Keep Tetra open on this device, on the same Wi-Fi as the computer: the map comes here by itself.
